## Super guarantee rate

From 1 July 2025, employers must contribute 12% of an employee's ordinary time
earnings for the quarter. This applies for the 2025-26 income year. The rate was
11.5% for the 2024-25 income year.

## Maximum contribution base

For the 2025-26 income year the maximum contribution base is $62,500 per
quarter. An employer is not required to provide super guarantee on the part of
an employee's earnings above this limit for the quarter.
